name: Researcher Phase Transition → ARCHITECT
description: ADR-041 Slice 2D-3 forward spawn rule. Fires when phasevalidator.PhaseValidator has approved a synthesize→architect transition and stamped chain.phase_transition.proceed.architect="true" on the source researcher-synthesize loop entity. The validator has checked the edge AND the per-phase cap (max 2 architect fires per chain). Same two-step fire shape as the other phase-transition rules.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.researcher-architect
on_enter.prompt:
ARCHITECT phase entry. Source loop $entity.instance (researcher-synthesize) has handed off with decide(action="architect"). The synthesized research artifact lives at $entity.triple.research.artifact.path (rendered by emit_research_artifact under the deployment's SEMTEAMS_RESEARCH_ARTIFACT_DIR; mounted into the sandbox at /artifacts/research/ in production).

Iteration 1 — call bash `cat $entity.triple.research.artifact.path` to read the full structured artifact (actors, integration_points, tasks, addressed_gaps, open_gaps, verifiable outcomes). read_loop_result returns only the synthesize loop's decide() reason, not the typed artifact body — bash the file to get the substance you need to architect against. If the substitution did not resolve (the literal token `$entity.triple.research.artifact.path` appears in the bash command), the upstream emit_research_artifact render failed; terminate with decide(action="needs_clarification", reason="research.artifact.path triple absent on synthesize loop — emit_research_artifact render likely failed").

Iteration 2+ — extract concrete typed commitments + verification checks[] that bind verifiable outcomes to executable evidence per researcher-architect/00-identity.md. Use scratchpad to decompose actors → checks before the strict-schema emit_dev_via_spec_artifact call.

Terminal options (allow-list enforced by phasevalidator): decide(action="emit") forward terminal — closes the research arc, dev-via-spec reviewer evaluates next via 01b; decide(action="gather") back-edge if architecture surfaces an unindexed dep (bounded by gather cap=3); decide(action="needs_clarification") when the synthesized artifact is structurally insufficient for architecture.

metadata.proceed_sentinel: chain.phase_transition.proceed.architect on source researcher-synthesize loop entity
metadata.chain_mode_gate: Coordinator-redesign Slice 1b: this rule's single condition (proceed.architect eq "true") IS the gate the validator's chain.mode check expresses. PhaseValidator.modeGateRejects refuses to write proceed.architect when the chain entity carries chain.mode.classification == "research_only"; absent the proceed sentinel, this rule never fires. The proceed-sentinel pattern keeps the rule JSON entity-local (rule conditions read the firing loop entity's triples; chain.mode lives on the chain entity and is not directly accessible from rule conditions). Counter-pattern for cases where rules NEED mode forking: ADR-041 addendum 2026-05-16 introduces a validator-side mirror — the validator writes chain.mode.classification onto the source-loop entity at synthesize-approval time so rules 05a / 05b can fork on mode. The same pattern could extend here if architect ever needs mode-divergent allowlists. As of this rule, the validator's suppression of proceed.architect under research_only is sufficient; no mirror needed for architect.
metadata.research_artifact_path_substitution: Smoke #24 (2026-05-14) finding: read_loop_result on the synthesize loop returns only the decide() terminal reason, not the typed emit_research_artifact payload. Architect must bash cat the rendered markdown to access actors/integration_points/tasks/checks. The $entity.triple.research.artifact.path substitution flows the path from emit_research_artifact's stamping (cmd/semteams/tools/emitartifact/executor.go:271-299) — NOT hardcoded. Resolves to whatever SEMTEAMS_RESEARCH_ARTIFACT_DIR points at; in production e2e this is /artifacts/research/<slug>.md (shared volume mounted ro into sandbox). Failure mode: triple absent → literal token in command → bash exits non-zero → architect terminates with needs_clarification naming the missing triple. Pairs with cmd/semteams/sandbox/server.go handleExec lazy autocreate (same slice) — non-builder roles reach /exec before bootstrap_workspace runs.
